title: DeLorean vs Cybertruck: Two Stainless Steel Bets
description:
Two vehicles, forty years apart, both with unpainted stainless steel bodies and big promises. The DeLorean DMC-12 targeted twelve thousand dollars and launched at twenty-five thousand. The Tesla Cybertruck was shown at thirty-nine thousand, nine hundred ninety and launched at sixty thousand, nine hundred ninety. This video compares the two bets using published numbers, and shows where they are not comparable. Our sources are Wikipedia pages on the DeLorean DMC-12, the Cybertruck, John DeLorean and the Texas DeLorean company, plus Business Insider, Yahoo Autos, InsideEVs and ThePricer. The pages sometimes disagree with each other, and the two vehicles were sold in very different eras. Our own arithmetic is labelled.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
